obs_meaning.leg_angle: [sin L, sin R, cos L, cos R] of the leg angle in rad; 0 = leg straight forward, + = rolled forward
obs_meaning.leg_vel: [L, R] leg speed in rad/s divided by max_speed_rad_s (+ = rolling forward)
obs_meaning.last_action: the previous policy output [L, R] (after clipping to [-1, 1]); zeros at the start
obs_meaning.gyro_z: yaw rate in rad/s, chassis frame, + = turning left (counterclockwise seen from above)
obs_meaning.heading_error: yaw in rad since the start (dm.imu_reset_yaw_axis() at the start), + = turned left

action: [L, R] in [-1, 1]; motor speed command = action * max_command_frac * max_speed_rad_s (= action * 60 percent). Never command more than 60%: the sim was only checked against the real robot up to 50% and goes 2x too far at 100%
normalization: inside the exported model (feed raw observations as above)
action_delay_in_training: 0 to 1 control steps, uniform, redrawn every step

real_robot.control_loop: one BLOCKING batch of motor_run (left + right) per step, never a new command before the last is confirmed; measured median round trip 60 ms (95th pct 90, max 118) -> 16 Hz

heading_error.convert: rad = wrap_to_pi(radians(raw / 10)); call dm.imu_reset_yaw_axis(0) before starting
heading_error.sign: + = turned left, same as the sim

gyro_z.source: dm.imu_device.gyroscopeZ (z is the yaw axis; x and y barely moved during a 90 deg turn)
gyro_z.raw_unit: deg/s (measured 1.08-1.14 raw units per deg/s; treat as deg/s, about 10% uncertain)
gyro_z.sign: + = turning left, same as the sim

real_robot.leg_angle: radians(forward_sign(dir) * dm.motor[i].position) after lego_common.zero_relative_at_home(); 0 = straight forward, + = rolled forward (left counts down when walking forward; verified in the 2026-11-16 walk logs)
real_robot.leg_vel: forward_sign(dir) * dm.motor[i].speed / 100 * max_speed_rad_s; speed is percent of max, same sign as position (walk logs: -24/+24 at 25%, -49/+49 at 50%, -99/+99 at 100% for L/R)
real_robot.runner: scripts/run_policy.py implements all of the above
real_robot.action_to_motor: a = clip(a, -1, 1); percent = round(60 * abs(a)) (at most 60%); direction = LEFT_FORWARD / RIGHT_FORWARD if a >= 0 else the opposite (lego_common)
